assets.description: The measured layer: named ranges, plateaux and basins of the region, surveyed summit elevations, river centrelines, world coastlines and recorded urban footprints.
assets.creator: Natural Earth. Primary authors Tom Patterson and Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso.
assets.licence: Public domain. "No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary." https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
assets.attributionGiven: Credited on the plates themselves and in the page source, though the licence does not require it.
assets.modifications: Downloaded and trimmed to the region by scripts/fetch-geodata.mjs (feature filtering, vertex decimation, coordinate rounding). Rendered to SVG and rasterised by scripts/build-geo.mjs: projected equirectangular and orthographic, coloured to the page palette, graded, grained, written as responsive AVIF and WebP. No coordinate was moved and no feature was invented.
assets.appearsIn: Journey chapters one to four, the guide section, and both layers of the Blood Goat climax.
